title: VtM5e Predator Types
description: Standalone, complete Predator Type compendium (all 16 corebook types) - split out of vtm5e-disciplines, which had been used as a dumping ground for anything wod5e doesn't have a dedicated pack for. Also replaces the community compendium's own predator-type entries, which duplicated 7 of these with unverified dice pools (all defaulted to Wits + Awareness, contradicting the corebook's own Predator Pools table, p.307-308). Not published; built for personal use.
